text:
The Ann–Ben block is consecutive, with Cara before Elif before Ann before Hana, and Gus at least three slots after Ann. The only placement that also keeps Dev at least three from Ann, Ben, and Cara (and before Gus) is Ann in 6 and Ben in 7, which forces Gus into 9 and Hana into 8.

Slots 1–5 are then fixed: Elif must take 5 (Finn, Ivo, and Dev are all too close to Ben to sit there), Dev must take 1 (the only slot at least three from Cara), Finn must take 2 (at least three from Elif), and Ivo takes 3. Both noted swaps break a distance rule: Finn in 3 is only two from Elif, and Dev in 2 is only two from Cara.

SCHEDULE: {"1":"Dev","2":"Finn","3":"Ivo","4":"Cara","5":"Elif","6":"Ann","7":"Ben","8":"Hana","9":"Gus"}
CONFIDENCE: 98
